title: Email updates for parents and guardians
intro: Occasional team news by email: meeting recaps, tournament dates and travel, and what the team needs from families.
points: Signing up happens on {provider}, the service that sends the team's emails. Your address goes to {provider}, not to this site.
{provider} emails you a link to confirm. Nothing is sent to you until you do.
Every email has a link to unsubscribe with one click.
